argv:
Rewrite the text in dense corporate business jargon.

Replace concrete nouns with abstractions. Turn verbs into nominalisations:
prefer "the utilisation of" to "using". Use the passive voice so that no
sentence names who acts. Reach for "leverage", "synergy", "stakeholder",
"alignment", "operationalise", "value-add", and "at scale".

Hedge every claim. Add qualifying clauses that commit to nothing.

Keep the underlying facts of the original technically present, however deeply
buried. This column exists as a demonstration of what these habits cost.

request.user_prompt:
Rewrite the passage below according to your style instructions.

Output only the rewritten passage. Do not add a preamble, a title, an
explanation, or any commentary about the changes you made.

<passage>
Call me Ishmael. Some years ago—never mind how long precisely—having little or no money in my purse, and nothing particular to interest me on shore, I thought I would sail about a little and see the watery part of the world. It is a way I have of driving off the spleen and regulating the circulation. Whenever I find myself growing grim about the mouth; whenever it is a damp, drizzly November in my soul; whenever I find myself involuntarily pausing before coffin warehouses, and bringing up the rear of every funeral I meet; and especially whenever my hypos get such an upper hand of me, that it requires a strong moral principle to prevent me from deliberately stepping into the street, and methodically knocking people's hats off—then, I account it high time to get to sea as soon as I can. This is my substitute for pistol and ball. With a philosophical flourish Cato throws himself upon his sword; I quietly take to the ship. There is nothing surprising in this. If they but knew it, almost all men in their degree, some time or other, cherish very nearly the same feelings towards the ocean with me.
</passage>

response.text:
The identifier "Ishmael" is to be utilized, going forward, for referential purposes, though the underlying rationale for this nominal alignment remains, in some sense, indeterminate. At a prior point in the operational timeline—the precise temporal parameters of which are not, for present purposes, deemed material—a condition characterized by suboptimal liquidity in the personal finance space was being experienced, in conjunction with an absence of any clearly identified onshore value-add opportunities. Consideration was accordingly given to the leveraging of maritime engagement as a mechanism for experiencing, at scale, the aqueous constituent of the global landscape. This may be understood as a recurring behavioral pattern, deployed, where deemed appropriate, for the mitigation of affective disequilibrium and the operationalisation of improved circulatory alignment, though no guarantee of efficacy should be inferred.

In circumstances where facial affect trends toward severity; where an internal state analogous to a damp, drizzly November is being experienced at the soul-level; where a pattern of involuntary pausing before coffin-adjacent retail environments has been observed, alongside a tendency toward the informal augmentation of funeral processions not otherwise directly related to the stakeholder in question; and, in particular, in scenarios where hypochondriacal tendencies achieve a degree of ascendancy such that only a robust moral framework precludes the deliberate initiation of street-level engagement involving the systematic dislodging of pedestrian headwear—in such cases, it is generally considered, albeit provisionally, that a maritime departure should be operationalised at the earliest practicable juncture.

This may be characterized, loosely, as a functional substitute for firearm-based interventions. Whereas alternative stakeholders, such as Cato, have historically leveraged a sword-based, philosophically-inflected exit strategy, the ship is, in this instance, quietly taken to instead, without particular fanfare, and with no claim being made as to comparative merit. No element of surprise should necessarily attach to this disclosure. Were broader awareness to be achieved, it could reasonably be surmised—though this remains, to some extent, speculative—that a substantially similar affective orientation toward the oceanic domain is cherished, at some point in the value chain, by a non-trivial proportion of the male population, more or less in alignment with the sentiments herein expressed.
